known.title: Gate: the local close test misses real repository conditions

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - close a pushed Forge pull request in local mode while a GitHub test job is queued.
The new local-mode assertion supplies a queued `tests` check, but the fixture starts an unpushed branch and reports no open pull request (`tests/test_close.py:223` and `:310`). Consequently, the pre-push wait in `src/forge/checks.py:252` returns before examining that check, even though it waits on active jobs for an existing PR. The fixture also omits `.forge/always-tests.txt`, whose entries `src/forge/fasttest.py:835` adds to the real repository's selection. The test can therefore pass while local close both waits for a GitHub test job and runs unrelated required tests. Exercise the existing-PR path and the repository's required-test list so the proof detects those failures.
findings.title: Gate: the local close test misses real repository conditions
